issue_request: FHIR-5403 was a Published FHIR-core DSTU1 ballot comment, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, criticizing the resource model as lacking conceptual layering and conceptual integrity and suggesting framework principles such as trade-offs, evolution, integration, consistency, and an architectural review process. The approved resolution was that much work had gone into this area since the ballot comment.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5403 was found, and the issue did not identify a concrete source hunk or conformance rule to apply. Later source evolution, especially commit 16b77d47f2a179ae6a2543bcb19b820ebf9883b1 adding source/overview-arch.html, supplied the architect overview, architectural principles, decomposition, and resource organization discussion.
additional_context: The current build navigation includes the general overview, architect overview, summary, conformance rules, resource guide, and related framework pages. These pages explain FHIR's modular resource framework, composition, profiling, extensibility, conformance layer, resource governance, architectural principles, decomposition, and organizing layers. Exact Jira concept searches found only FHIR-5403, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting decision evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current specification already addresses the broad architecture/layering concern, and the Jira disposition is too non-specific to justify adding new normative or informative wording beyond the existing active pages.
